sampling: 31 one-second observations, including both endpoints. Existing cached NBHL recording, new temporal identity labels; not an independent recording.
context: Use the identical 315-second window starting at2385seconds for native SAM3 and cached raw SAM2; the audit begins135seconds into their runs.
identity_selection: At the first frame, enumerate clearly visible floor players excluding officials, goalies, bench and spectators, in increasing horizontal-center order. Choose up to four evenly spaced indices across this list. Track only these initial players. Record visible, out_of_view or uncertain at each sample; never force identity through an ambiguous crossing.
annotation: Assistant visual review of raw video/frames and detector proposals only, without viewing candidate tracking IDs. Review proposal localization and manually refine a box if needed. Proposal assistance can bias localization; disclose this limitation.
metrics: Existing one-second supplementary audit: box IoU0.5primary/0.3sensitivity, visible observation coverage and adjacent-visible identity changes/missing transitions. No tuning or model selection from this audit.
limits: Short sparse identity sample within a reused recording, not full-game accuracy, TOI or a verified jersey roster.
